title: Clinical Coordination Manager
description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

description:

  • Fantastic Computer Science fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, networking, distributed systems, databases, and everything in between!

We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. This role is for someone who holds a high bar on execution and moves fast. We use AI to speed up our GTM work, and we expect you to do the same. We also expect you to be the person who catches generic, low-effort output before it reaches a customer. Our brand and our customer experience matter too much to ship anything less than excellent.

Work with Design to keep them accurate, on-brand, and easy for reps to find

  • Coach reps alongside sales managers: review calls, run role plays, and use call and deal data to spot skill gaps and sharpen messaging

  • Run competitive intelligence: track what competitors ship and say, turn it into battle cards and training reps use in live deals, and flag what matters to Product and leadership

  • Measure what works: track ramp time, win rates, conversion, and content usage with RevOps, report on the impact of enablement programs, and cut what isn't working

  • Drive adoption of our sales tools (HubSpot, call recording, and AI tools), and build workflows and automations that save reps time

  • Translate new features and market shifts into training and materials within days, not weeks, so Sales, CX, and Growth all work from the same story

What we're looking for

  • 3 - 5 years in GTM or sales enablement, sales training, or a similar role at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company

  • Strong facilitation and coaching skills: you can run an engaging workshop, give direct feedback on a call recording, and adapt to reps at different experience levels

  • Strong stakeholder management: you work across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and CX with different goals, and keep reps up to date on process and product changes without slowing anyone down

  • Strong product sense: you pick up a technical product and a new market quickly and can explain both simply

  • Clear judgment on AI-generated content: you use AI to move faster, you know when it makes the work worse, and you push back when quality slips

  • A strong eye for quality: you notice off-brand colors, inconsistent fonts, and misaligned elements, and you're comfortable making clean edits in Figma, Google Slides, or similar

  • Proven ability to prioritize in a fast-moving environment, where priorities change weekly

  • An ability and willingness to travel between our two offices (New York and Berlin) once a quarter

  • Excellent written English. You write clearly and cut anything that doesn't earn its place

Bonus points

  • Prior quota-carrying experience as an Account Executive or SDR

  • Experience at an early-stage company during a period of rapid scale

  • Fluent German, French, Spanish, or a Nordic language

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Collaborative, high-energy in-office work environment

Own the controls engineering for new magnet factory equipment supporting coil winding, impregnation, joining, and end-of-line testing.

Architect control systems and develop PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) software, primarily on Beckhoff platforms.

Partner with mechanical, process, and manufacturing engineers to translate production requirements into robust, well-documented automation solutions.

  • Specify and implement field network topology (e.g., EtherCAT, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, OPC-UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture)) connecting equipment, sensors, and upstream/downstream systems.

  • Set up and tune servo drives and VFDs (Variable Frequency Drives) for precision motion control on winding, handling, and assembly equipment.

  • Design intuitive HMI (Human-Machine Interface)/SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) screens for operator use and troubleshooting.

  • Commission new equipment end-to-end: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test)/SAT (Site Acceptance Test), installation, integration, and initial process validation.

  • Use hand tools and diagnostic instruments (multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.) for hands-on electrical troubleshooting during build and commissioning.

  • Implement control-reliable safety systems in line with relevant machine safety and electrical standards.

  • Document control architecture, code, and equipment operation to support handover and future sustaining work.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing, mechanical, and process engineers to ensure controls solutions match the realities of magnet coil production.

WHO YOU ARE

  • In-depth knowledge of Beckhoff controls systems (TwinCAT 3).

  • Good Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) programming skills.

  • Able to use common hand tools and diagnostic instruments such as multimeters.

  • Proficiency in field network topology, both theory and practical applications.

  • 2–5 years of experience in controls engineering for manufacturing or automation equipment, ideally on electromechanical or precision systems.

  • Experience commissioning servo drives/VFDs and integrating sensors, actuators, and safety devices.

  • Familiarity with HMI/SCADA platforms (TwinCAT HMI, WinCC, Ignition, or similar).

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CAD (Computer-Aided Design) electrical drafting tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN).

  • Scripting experience (Python, SQL) for data acquisition or MES (Manufacturing Execution System)/database integration.

  • Machine vision experience.

  • Greenfield or startup equipment commissioning experience.

  • Working knowledge of relevant electrical and machine safety standards (e.g., EN (European Norm) 60204-1, IEC 61439, ISO (International Organization for Standardization) 13849).

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Develop and industrialize the manufacturing processes used to build HTS magnet coils.

Translate magnet designs into repeatable, high-yield production processes in collaboration with design, physics, and production teams.

Own the tooling, fixtures, and quality systems required to deliver consistent and reliable manufacturing outcomes.

Lead process development from prototype builds through the transition to full-scale manufacturing.

  • Develop, qualify, and continuously improve manufacturing processes for HTS coil winding, insulation, impregnation, and joining, working closely with magnet design and materials engineers.

  • Drive design-for-manufacturing/design-for-assembly (DFM (Design for Manufacturing)/DFA (Design for Assembly)) collaboration with the design team, acting as the manufacturing voice in design reviews to keep coil designs buildable, scalable, and serviceable.

  • Design, procure, and validate tooling, fixtures, and jigs for precision winding and assembly of non-planar coil geometries, including capability studies where needed.

  • Define and implement process controls and inspection methods (dimensional, electrical, structural) to catch defects early and protect conductor integrity.

  • Support supplier qualification and incoming inspection criteria for tooling, components, and outsourced subassemblies.

  • Manage engineering/process change control as designs and processes mature.

  • Experience supporting prototype or first-article builds directly on the floor, not just from a desk.

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
About us

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.

This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.

This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.

What You’ll do

  • Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.

  • Talk to users directly. Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.

  • Do your own data work. You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.

  • Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan. Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.

  • Design and run tests. Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.

  • Drive product development from concept to launch. Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making

  • Own the outcome, not the output. Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.

  • Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in product, with meaningful time on products where the software coordinates real-world processes - staffing, logistics, fintech ops, healthcare, or similar, with substantial business impact. You have experience in marketplace dynamics and allocation problems.

  • You've shipped something complex end-to-end and can talk credibly about what broke, not just what launched.

  • You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists.

  • You've moved teams you don't manage. Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job.

  • You write and speak clearly. This is the strongest single signal we look for, because in a cross-team role, clear communication is most of how work actually moves.

  • AI is already part of how you work, and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers

  • English fluency. German is a big plus.

What we offer

  • Real ownership of problems that visibly move the business - not a slice of someone else's roadmap.

  • Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard.

  • Unique team spirit: We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team.

  • Vacation: Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave

  • Hybrid working model: We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).

  • Dog-lover: If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks

  • Personal growth: Ongoing focus on your personal development (annual training budget of EUR 750, mentoring opportunities, constant career development conversations)

  • Healthy mind in a healthy body: With us you will receive a 30 EUR Urban Sports Club grant to keep you fit. In addition, we have a small sports room in the office ourselves.

  • Always mobile: You will receive EUR 40 credit per month for NAVIT, a sustainable mobility tool for public transport, bike sharing and much more.

  • Legendary Events: Quarterly team events, winter and summer parties, budget for birthdays and anniversaries of our employees

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

title: Founder Associate (Berlin)
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

As our Founder Associate, you sit in the founders' office and work directly with the founders and Chief of Staff to shape and execute the initiatives that drive Prior Labs' growth. You get real ownership of business functions, with broad exposure across the company, from strategy to execution.

We run our business functions with defined areas of ownership: Growth, Sales & Enablement, Marketing & Community, and People Ops. You pick up ownership across these areas based on what the company needs and where you're strongest, and you go deep where you have the most impact.

Everything we do is AI-first, so you'll spend less time on the grunt work and more time building the systems that make it obsolete.

Core Areas of Impact

Below are examples of what you could own:

Growth

Leads that reach Prior Labs get qualified, enriched, scored, and routed automatically. You own that engine, make it better, and find the next channel.

  • Own the inbound pipeline end to end

  • Remove the manual steps that are left: better scoring, smarter routing, more automation

  • Build the pipeline reporting the founders and sales team actually use

  • Test new channels: data sources, outbound angles, our first paid experiments

  • Own tracking and attribution, so we know where pipeline actually comes from

Sales Enablement

Our sales team talks to some of the largest companies in the world. You build everything around their conversations so they can focus on selling.

  • Automate call prep: short briefings so no one walks into a call cold

  • Own decks, case studies, battle cards, and demo assets

  • Keep POCs on track: milestones, follow-ups, next steps

  • Turn closed deals into reference stories and case studies

Ops & Automation

We think most internal work can be automated with today's AI, and your job is to do it.

  • Pick the most annoying recurring workflow each month and automate it

title: Graduate Program (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

Every day, millions of travelers book buses, trains, ferries and transfers through platforms they know, and many of those bookings run on Distribusion. We connect hundreds of carriers with the world’s leading travel retailers, making ground transport as easy to book as a flight.


We’re looking for ambitious graduates who want real responsibility from day one. As part of our Graduate Program, you’ll join one of our core teams as an Analyst or Engineer, work on live products used across the globe, and learn alongside people who are building the infrastructure of ground travel.

Workplace: Berlin & Remote or willing to relocate to Berlin.

Where you could make your mark

Product: Analyst roles

  • Search Engine & Booking Platform: Build the core engine that returns fast, scalable search results and handles thousands of booking requests per second.

  • Supply & Integrations: Connect hundreds of external carrier APIs and help build robust, fault‑tolerant infrastructure that keeps bookings flowing.

  • E‑commerce: Shape the booking engines, payment flows and user journeys that let travelers search, book, pay for and manage trips. Your work directly moves conversion and retention for a global audience across many markets, currencies and languages.

  • Connectivity: Build enterprise‑grade integrations with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, CRMs and government authorities, with a strong focus on automation and innovation.

Tech: Engineer roles

  • Demand Engineering: Work on the heart of our platform: the search and booking engine that lets the world’s biggest travel retailers sell bus and rail tickets through a single API, and the schedule system behind hundreds of thousands of daily departures used by hundreds of operators. Build high‑throughput microservices, help modernize our core search engine, and shape the product, not just the code.

  • Content Engineering: Build the pipelines that keep global travel data accurate and up to date. Automate how we ingest stations, prices and schedule changes in real time, and apply AI to keep millions of data points reliable at scale.

Partnerships

  • Regional Partnerships: Work hands‑on with bus, rail, ferry and transfer operators and leading travel retailers in your region, guiding them from first integration to growing their bookings across our global network.

  • Corporate Partnerships: Bring ground transport into business travel by working with travel management companies, corporate travel agencies and booking tools, from technical onboarding to growing the partnership.

  • Performance & Growth: Dig into partner data, spot opportunities, and build the processes and automation that help us scale.



Who you are:

  • STEM or tech-related academic background - You’re a recent (or soon-to-be) graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Business/Information Systems, or a similar field.
    Analytical mindset & problem-solving     - You love digging into complex problems, understanding how things work, and turning ambiguity into clear, structured solutions.

  • Technical curiosity: You have a basic understanding of APIs, systems or digital products (through studies, internships or projects), and you’re excited to build with AI, whether that’s experimenting with new tools, prototyping ideas or putting AI to work on real problems in a high‑scale environment.

  • Strong communication - You can explain ideas clearly, whether talking to engineers, product managers, or business teams — and you enjoy bridging technical and non-technical worlds.

  • Collaborative & cross-functional - You like working with diverse teams and feel comfortable contributing to group projects, Agile teamwork, and shared problem-solving.

  • Fast learner & adaptable - You thrive in dynamic environments, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and stay resilient when things change or are not fully defined.

  • Ownership & ambition - You’re eager to take responsibility early, bring ideas to the table, and help shape processes that improve how products get delivered.


What you can expect:

  • Global reach & real-world impact - You help build software that enables travel for millions of people globally; your work supports real journeys across countries and continents, and makes transportation more accessible.

  • Cutting-edge tech in a high‑scale environment - From microservices and real-time search to AI-based content automation and cloud infrastructure, you’ll gain hands-on experience with many modern technologies and complex systems.

  • Fast growth & startup energy - Distribusion is rapidly expanding globally (70+ countries, hundreds of carriers/retailers), backed by strong funding — you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership early, learn fast, and grow with the company.

  • Variety: you can pick what excites you - Whether you like backend APIs, front‑end booking flows, data & analytics or product. There are many teams and disciplines where you can start, explore and specialise.

  • Meaningful mission — mobility & sustainability - By enabling efficient ground transportation (bus, rail, ferry) globally, Distribusion contributes to more sustainable travel alternatives to private cars or flights.

  • Global partnerships & industry exposure - You’ll collaborate with some of the biggest names in travel technology and national transportation, working directly with partners like Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • International team & inspiring culture - You’ll join a diverse, mission-driven team where talented people support, challenge, and learn from one another every day, a place to grow fast and make a real impact.

title: Backend Entwickler
description:
ERP-Software für die Bauwirtschaft aus Kiel

IDALABS entwickelt seit 2014 durchgängige und hochintegrierte ERP-Software, die Handwerks- und Industriebetriebe zukunftsfähig macht. Wir entwickeln bei IDALABS eine umfangreiche ERP-Software für die Bauwirtschaft. Kurz gesagt: Bei uns erwarten Dich echte Herausforderungen und viele Möglichkeiten, Dich technisch und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Wer gerne mitdenkt und Freude an durchdachten Lösungen hat, ist bei uns richtig.

Deine Aufgaben in der Entwicklung

Als Backend Entwickler gestaltest du unsere ERP-Lösungen aktiv mit und treibst die technische Umsetzung voran. Du arbeitest in unserem Team direkt vor Ort in Kiel an anspruchsvollen Softwarearchitekturen.

Für unser aktuell fünfköpfiges Entwicklungsteam suchen wir Verstärkung. Jemanden, der PHP nicht erst gestern entdeckt hat, verzwickte Abhängigkeiten spannend findet und Lust hat, Softwareentwicklung mit KI auf das nächste Level zu bringen.

Womit Du Dich bei uns beschäftigst

  • PHP 8.x: Das ist unsere Backend-Welt, und die solltest Du ziemlich gut kennen. Wir setzen auf keines der großen Frameworks, sondern haben unsere Architektur weitgehend selbst entwickelt. Du arbeitest also mit einem System, das Du wirklich verstehen kannst, bis in die Tiefe.

  • MariaDB: Unsere Datenbank ist groß und anspruchsvoll. Wer gerne in Datenmodellen denkt, wird hier glücklich.

  • Architektur & Geschäftslogik: Unsere Software kann eine Menge. Die spannende Aufgabe besteht darin, sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, neue Funktionen zu integrieren und ihre Architektur nachhaltig zu verbessern.

  • Agentisches Entwickeln: Wir sind überzeugt, dass KI die Softwareentwicklung grundlegend verändert. Wir wollen diese Möglichkeiten konsequent nutzen, nicht nur, um Code schneller zu schreiben, sondern um intelligenter zu entwickeln. Schon heute erstellen wir zum Beispiel unsere Unit-Tests automatisiert mit KI.

  • Qualität: Jede Änderung durchläuft ein Peer-Review, und unsere CI läuft über Jenkins.

Wen wir suchen

Du hast Informatik studiert? Super.

Du hast nicht studiert, dafür aber viele Jahre anspruchsvolle Software entwickelt? Genauso gut.

Uns interessiert weniger, was auf Deinem Abschlusszeugnis steht, sondern was Du kannst, wie Du denkst und ob Du Lust hast, Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Was uns wichtig ist:

  • Du hast richtig gute Erfahrung mit PHP und relationalen Datenbanken.

  • Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne Funktionen, sondern auch das große Ganze einer Software.

  • Du arbeitest Dich gerne in bestehende Systeme ein und entwickelst sie mit Freude nachhaltig weiter.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst mit und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Du hast richtig Lust auf KI-gestützte, idealerweise agentische Softwareentwicklung. Erste Erfahrungen sind klasse, echte Neugier ist Pflicht.

  • Du kannst mit anderen Menschen kommunizieren. Klingt selbstverständlich, ist es aber nicht immer. ;-)

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Ein Unternehmen, das seit 2017 Software entwickelt und dabei noch lange nicht fertig ist.

Ein kleines Entwicklungsteam mit fünf Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, diskutieren und gemeinsam Lösungen finden. Kurze Wege, direkte Kommunikation und die Möglichkeit, tatsächlich etwas zu bewegen.

Wir sitzen in Kiel und arbeiten am liebsten gemeinsam im Büro. Nicht, weil wir noch nie von Homeoffice gehört haben, sondern weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass gute Zusammenarbeit vom direkten Austausch lebt.

Dafür gibt's flexible Arbeitszeiten, vernünftige Ausstattung, Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung, ein Fitnessangebot und natürlich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, mit denen man auch mal lachen kann.

Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst. Uns selbst nicht immer.

Klingt nach Dir?

Dann würden wir Dich gerne kennenlernen.

Schick uns ein paar Informationen über Dich, Deinen bisherigen Weg und vielleicht auch ein Beispiel dafür, woran Du zuletzt gearbeitet hast. Uns interessiert übrigens besonders, wie Du heute KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt oder wie Du es gerne tun würdest.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Dann gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Schritte!

Im Rahmen eines Projekts mit dem Digitalministeriums und der KfW haben wir zudem einen Prozess entwickelt, über den Gründer*innen ihre Gewerbeanmeldung und steuerliche Erfassung vollständig digital erledigen können. Das erwartet dich

Bugs bereitest du mit nachvollziehbaren Reproduktionsschritten, erwartetem und tatsächlichem Verhalten sowie relevanten Kontextinformationen für die IT auf. Du verfolgst die Bearbeitung und eskalierst bei Bedarf.

  • Lösungen qualitätssichern: Du prüfst Fehlerbehebungen anhand konkreter Testfälle, kontrollierst betroffene Prozessschritte und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse. Erst wenn die Lösung geprüft ist, meldest du den Fall als gelöst zurück.

  • Supportstrukturen aufbauen: Du gestaltest ein schlankes Ticketsystem mit klaren Kategorien, Zuständigkeiten, Reaktionszeiten und Eskalationswegen. Du etablierst nachvollziehbare Übergaben und dokumentierst Abläufe so, dass später weitere Kolleg*innen gut einsteigen können.

  • Wissen zugänglich machen: Du baust eine Wissensdatenbank, verständliche Hilfetexte und wiederverwendbare Antwortvorlagen auf. Dabei berücksichtigst du die unterschiedlichen Fragen von Gründer*innen und Kommunen und ermöglichst Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe.

Dabei nimmst du Fragen live auf, besprichst konkrete Anliegen und erklärst Lösungen verständlich. Offene Punkte überführst du in den Supportprozess und begleitest ihre Klärung.

title: (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description:
At aedifion, you will actively shape the future of energy-efficient building operations. Our mission is to make existing buildings smarter, more sustainable, and easier to manage making a real contribution to CO₂ reduction. You'll join an innovative tech company that uses cutting-edge technologies like IoT, AI, and cloud solutions to enable sustainable real estate. Our culture? Open, diverse, and team-oriented. With more than 100 colleagues from various nations, we combine a wide range of expertise and perspectives to achieve big things together.

Your impact in this position:

As our (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d), your mission is to make sure our revenue organization grows in a way that is strong, predictable and scalable. You combine data analysis with consistent process automation, and you play a key part in giving Sales more time for what actually matters, in raising forecast quality to a new level, and in building a go-to-market (GTM) structure that scales with aedifion.

What you can expect:

  • Sales enablement roadmap: Take ownership of the prioritized sales enablement roadmap and drive it forward, so that manual work in Sales goes down step by step through workflow automation.

  • Forecast and pipeline: Define what good pipeline quality and forecast accuracy mean at aedifion, track how both develop, and turn what you see into concrete measures that make our planning more reliable.

  • Turning data into decisions: Analyze GTM data from different sources, spot patterns and connections, and translate them into clear recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on.

  • GTM process architecture: Design and improve the processes along the entire GTM funnel, set clear definitions and handovers between teams, and keep developing them based on your own analyses.

  • Building agents and governance: Build and roll out AI agents for recurring steps in GTM work, establish one common standard for how AI automation is used, and keep quality and oversight across all teams.

  • GTM tech stack: Evaluate tools against defined criteria, prepare well-founded decision papers, and shape together with our Head of Business Operations how new solutions fit into our existing tool landscape.

  • Strategic GTM planning: Create the analytical basis for decisions on growth, market coverage and compensation, so they rest on solid data and set the right incentives for our team.

At aedifion we foster an open and appreciative culture where everyone can develop freely, regardless of background, gender, age, ability or orientation. We offer a safe space for personal growth and independent work. Flexibility and openness matter to us, so that everyone can work with authenticity and enjoy what they do. We especially welcome applications from women.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
description:
Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to.

This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing.
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along.
  • Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards.
  • Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions.

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database.
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform.
  • Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion.
  • Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function.
  • A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents).
  • Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

 

Culture & Growth

What We Offer 

  • An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+. 
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly. 
  • Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact. 
  • Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution. 
  • Flexible Work: Work from home, the office or a hybrid mix. We focus on results, not clocking hours. 
  • Time Off and Wellbeing: 30 days of vacation and an EGYM Wellpass membership. 
  • Free Public Transport: A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for travel across Germany. 
  • Team Connection: Regular team dinners, company meetups and offsite events. 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation and growth is a shared journey.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

HörPartner: Qualität und Wachstum durch bestes Handwerk.

Seit der Gründung 1992 in Berlin-Köpenick stehen wir für hochwertige Hörgeräteversorgung und kompetenten Service. Heute sind wir der größte regionale Hörakustik-Anbieter in Berlin und Brandenburg mit über 55 Filialen (darunter in Hessen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Niedersachsen und NRW) und über 190 Mitarbeitenden.

Werden Sie Teil dieser Erfolgsgeschichte!

Für unsere Filiale in Berlin Hohenschönhausen suchen wir ab sofort einen:

Kundenberater / Serviceberater (m/w/d) in der Hörakustik

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben: Verantwortungsvoll, vielseitig und kundenorientiert

Sie sind die zentrale Ansprechperson in unserer Filiale und tragen maßgeblich zum Kundenerfolg bei:

  • Kundenbetreuung: Sie pflegen aktiv Kundenbeziehungen und sind der erste Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Fachgeschäft und am Telefon.
  • Organisation: Sie organisieren Kundentermine effizient und übernehmen die gesamte Kommunikationsabwicklung.
  • Beratung & Verkauf: Sie beraten unsere Kunden umfassend zum Hörakustik-Sortiment und verkaufen Produkte zur Steigerung ihrer Lebensqualität.
  • Service & Technik: Sie wickeln Reparaturaufträge ab und übernehmen die fachgerechte Reinigung und Pflege der Hörgeräte.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil: Darauf legen wir Wert

  • Kommunikation: Sie gehen gerne auf neue Menschen zu und überzeugen durch Ihre offene, einfühlsame und verbindliche Art.
  • Vertriebsaffinität: Sie lieben es zu beraten und zu verkaufen und haben eine Leidenschaft dafür, die Lebensqualität anderer zu verbessern.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Sie freuen sich über die Chance, Neues zu lernen, und lassen sich für neue Herausforderungen und Themen begeistern.
  • Hintergrund: Berufserfahrung ist nicht nötig – Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) sind herzlich willkommen!

Benefits

Wir bieten Ihnen: Stabilität und attraktive Vorteile

Sie erhalten einen Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten und seit 30 Jahren am Markt etablierten Unternehmen:

  • Regulierte Arbeitszeit: Unsere Öffnungszeiten sind nur Montag bis Freitag.
  • Planbarkeit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die wir an die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeiter anpassen.
  • Einarbeitung: Eine intensive, individuelle Einarbeitung mit einem festen Ansprechpartner, der Sie in den ersten Monaten begleitet und unterstützt.
  • Sicherheit: Ein krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem Wachstumsmarkt.
  • HörPartner Zusatzleistungen:
  • Versicherungen: Nach der Probezeit erhalten Sie eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung.
  • Mobilität & Vorsorge (optional): Jobrad, VBB-Jobticket und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge stehen zur Wahl.

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Leitung Vertriebsinnendienst und Prozesssteuerung (m/w/d)
description:
Worms · Vollzeit · unbefristet · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung
Berichtet direkt an: Head of Sales
Führt: Vertriebsinnendienst und Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling

Bei NICO entstehen gute Ergebnisse, wenn Menschen, Prozesse und Informationen zuverlässig zusammenspielen: Kalkulationen müssen stimmen, Angebote sorgfältig vorbereitet, Aufgaben klar verteilt und Entscheidungen durch belastbare Zahlen unterstützt werden.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Überblick behält, Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Menschen gute Lösungen entwickelt. Sie schaffen so viel Struktur wie nötig und halten Abläufe so einfach wie möglich.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle: Sie führen den Vertriebsinnendienst sowie die Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling fachlich und disziplinarisch. Dabei verantworten Sie die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Vertriebsprozesse. Klassische Kundenbetreuung steht nicht im Mittelpunkt dieser Position.

Sie koordinieren den Gesamtprozess – von Kalkulation und Angebot über Auftrag, Beschaffung und Lieferung bis zu Rechnung, Auswertung und Nachbereitung. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Zuständigkeiten geklärt sind, Informationen fließen und Entscheidungen auf verlässlichen Daten beruhen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie führen Ihr Team klar, wertschätzend und nah am Arbeitsalltag.

  • Sie steuern und verbessern die internen Vertriebsprozesse über alle Prozessschritte hinweg.

  • Sie koordinieren insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Buchhaltung und Logistik und beziehen IT sowie weitere beteiligte Bereiche rechtzeitig ein.

  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.

  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.

  • Sie erstellen und pflegen verständliche Prozessbeschreibungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Handbücher, Checklisten und Vorlagen.

  • Gemeinsam mit der IT verbessern Sie digitale Ablagen, Ordnerstrukturen, Berechtigungen und die Nutzung vorhandener Systeme.

  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.

  • Sie prüfen Zahlen auf Plausibilität, erkennen Abweichungen und Zusammenhänge und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst, in der Vertriebsorganisation, im Vertriebscontrolling oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion

  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Gesamtprozesse – von Kalkulation und Angebot bis zu Lieferung, Rechnung und Auswertung

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der bereichsübergreifenden Prozesskoordination

  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Auswertungen kritisch zu prüfen und verständlich einzuordnen

  • Erfahrung in der Dokumentation, Vereinheitlichung und Verbesserung von Abläufen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP- beziehungsweise Warenwirtschaftssystemen und den gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität sowie nachvollziehbare Ablage- und Informationsstrukturen

  • Offenheit für digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo diese Abläufe vereinfachen und die Qualität der Arbeit verbessern können

  • Eine verbindliche Kommunikation, ein respektvoller Führungsstil und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind hilfreich

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten möchten

Wir wünschen uns eine Führungskraft, die zuhört, nachfragt und die Erfahrung ihres Teams einbezieht. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Sie Entscheidungen treffen, Prioritäten setzen und vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent umsetzen.

Agile Zusammenarbeit bedeutet für uns ganz praktisch: Aufgaben sichtbar machen, Verantwortlichkeiten klären, sich regelmäßig abstimmen und Verbesserungen Schritt für Schritt umsetzen.

Zahlen verstehen wir dabei nicht als Selbstzweck. Sie sollen Entwicklungen sichtbar machen, Ursachen erkennen lassen und bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Was Sie bei der NICO erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit direkter Anbindung an den Head of Sales und spürbarem Einfluss auf die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen.

Sie treffen auf erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bestehende Strukturen und den gemeinsamen Wunsch, Abläufe transparenter, einfacher und verlässlicher zu gestalten. Dabei sollen Sie nicht vom ersten Tag an fertige Antworten liefern. Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie zunächst verstehen, dann bewerten und anschließend gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten die richtigen Veränderungen umsetzen.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle an unserem Standort in Worms, eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, kurze Abstimmungswege und eine der Verantwortung angemessene Vergütung.

Benefits

Warum Sie bei uns gut aufgehoben sind

  • Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit 10 Personen am Standort Worms, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt

  • Ein Familienunternehmen, das Stabilität, Bodenständigkeit und kurze Entscheidungswege vereint

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel, faire Vergütung und ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – besonders im Bereich Prozesse

  • Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag in einer spannenden und dynamischen Branche

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Zeiterfassungs/Abwesenheitssytem, regelmäßige Teammeetings und Firmenevents

  • monatliche Sachbezüge als Gutschein, die Ihnen nach der Probezeit zusätzliche Vorteile im Alltag bieten

Wir möchten Sie kennenlernen

Uns interessiert nicht nur Ihr Lebenslauf. Erzählen Sie uns auch, wie Sie führen, welche Prozesse Sie bereits verbessert haben und wie Sie Zahlen und Daten für gute Entscheidungen nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

NICO Feuerwerk GmbH
Am Guten Brunnen 10
67547 Worms

title: Senior Software Engineer C# / .NET (m/w/d)
description:
About this role

For our client, a global leader in metrology and process control for semiconductor manufacturing, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer C# / .NET (m/w/d) for a permanent position.

The team is based in Mannheim and has more than 25 years of experience building high-precision measurement systems. Their software looks down to the atomic level and turns what it sees into actionable data for the production of the world’s most advanced computer chips.

In this role you will design, build and maintain distributed software where performance, concurrency and reliability matter. You will also help shape how the team builds that software.

At a glance

  • Start: ASAP or by agreement

  • Contract: Contract, full-time

  • Setup: Hybrid, 3 days remote and 2 days on-site in Mannheim

  • Working language: English (German is a plus)

Your tasks

  • Design, develop, test and maintain scalable applications in C# and the .NET ecosystem

  • Write clean, well-documented code following Clean Architecture and the team’s coding standards

  • Work test-driven (TDD) and strengthen a culture of automated testing

  • Build robust multi-threaded solutions using locking, interlocking and parallelism in .NET

  • Turn business requirements into technical solutions together with product owners, architects and cross-functional teams

  • Review code and give constructive feedback to keep quality and consistency high

  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and provide technical guidance

  • Identify and drive improvements in architecture, performance, reliability and maintainability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across a distributed software stack

  • Contribute to CI/CD and modern delivery practices

Your profile

Must have

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of C# 14 and modern .NET

  • Several years of experience with multi-threaded programming

  • Several years of experience with high-volume in-memory data processing

  • Solid experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs

  • Strong command of OOP, SOLID, Clean Code, multi-layer architecture and TDD

  • Practical experience with automated testing: unit tests, component tests, mocking

  • Good working knowledge of UML

  • Proven experience in hardware-related software development

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics or a related field

  • Excellent English; you work well in international, cross-functional teams


Nice to have

  • Real-time systems, hardware integration or optical sensor data processing (strong plus)

  • Legacy modernization, such as migrating a monolith to distributed, service-oriented systems or microservices

  • Distributed system design: event-based and object-based architecture, fault detection, causality methods, fault tolerance

  • Relational database design

  • Front-end development with .NET MAUI

  • German language skills

What we offer

  • A contract position at a global technology leader in a growing industry

  • Technically demanding work at the intersection of software, hardware and physics

  • A hybrid setup with 3 days remote per week

  • An international team that values clean engineering and code quality

  • Real influence on architecture, and the chance to mentor other developers

  • Personal support from us throughout the hiring process

Interested?

Send us your CV with your salary expectations and notice period. Unsure whether you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We’d rather talk to you than miss a good match.

Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
Assistant General Counsel – Product and Regulatory Legal (EU)
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

 

The opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

  • Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs

  • Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)

  • Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework

  • Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products

  • Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively

  • Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions

  • Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally

  • Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team

  • Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves

  • Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")

  • Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State

  • 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience

  • Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation

  • Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken

  • Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations

  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA

  • Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

  • A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

  • Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience advising on tokenised securities and the European Union Distributed Ledger Technology Pilot Regime

  • Experience with EMIR, including the clearing obligation, margin for non-centrally cleared derivatives and transaction reporting

  • Experience with prime brokerage, securities financing, margin lending or institutional custody

  • Experience advising on the United Kingdom cryptoasset regime or other non-European Union frameworks that intersect with European Union operations

  • Experience supporting regulatory aspects of corporate transactions, such as change-of-control notifications and entity migrations

  • Experience with European Union data protection and consumer protection rules as they apply to financial products

  • Fluency in a second European language

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
